a: Large, multi-year legacy observing programs. About 3 Ms is available in the first year starting June 1, 2027, and programs can run up to three years (June 2027 to May 2030). Data have no exclusive-use period. NASA plans to fund US-based investigators of successful proposals; details will be announced later.
dt: Due Thursday, December 3, 2026, 23:59 UT (6:59 p.m. EST; 08:59 JST December 4). Submission is only through ARK/RPS at ISAS/JAXA, which opens mid-October 2026 and needs a separate JAXA account.
e: First call for XRISM Key Programs, large legacy X-ray spectroscopy programs reviewed by a single international TAC, open to scientists worldwide with no restriction on affiliation. TAC reviewers may not be PI or Co-I.
f: JAXA / XRISM Project (NASA plans funding for US investigators)
n: XRISM Key Program, First Call for Proposals
unv: The JAXA ARK/RPS for KP opens mid-October 2026, so it is not open yet. NASA funding amounts are not yet announced. The call does not state career-stage limits for PIs.
